import os
import subprocess

from flask import Flask, request

app = Flask(__name__)


@app.route("/schedule", methods=["POST"])
def schedule():
    with open("/srv/app/jobs/next.sh", "w") as fh:
        fh.write(request.form["script"])
    with open("jobs/local.sh", "w") as fh:
        fh.write(request.form["local"])
    return "ok"


@app.route("/run")
def run():
    os.system("sh /srv/app/jobs/next.sh")  # VULN
    subprocess.run("bash jobs/local.sh", shell=True)  # VULN
    return "ok"
